description:
Creates a drop cap from the first letter of the current paragraph. A drop cap is a large initial letter that
drops down two or more lines.

params.description: The drop cap type: "none" removes the drop cap, "drop" placesit within the text, "margin" places it in the margin.
params.name: position

returns.description: The created drop cap, or null if the drop cap could not be created or was removed.
